ACTUAL PRIMARY: S2.p2 defines real O(n) by transpose(O)*O=I, equipped with Haar probability, states the two determinant components each have mass 1/2, and defines mu_{n,b} as Haar probability conditioned on determinant b. A2.Thmtheorem7.p1 assumes n>=3 and kappa>=4 for the single-block separation. In A2.SS2.SSS2.p3, A2.Ex56 defines H(lambda) using det(O) and the Gaussian-density integral; p3.2 invokes half-mass; A2.Ex57 turns it into the half-weighted difference of P_{+1}/P_{-1} test expectations; A2.E20 then bounds TV by 2|H(lambda)|. The cited paragraph gives no reflection/partition proof of its half-mass invocation. Current theorem formalizes the isolated half-mass prerequisite and explicitly disclosed elementary expansion, not the complete paragraph or its expectation identity.

MEANING OF THE ACTUAL LAW: orthogonalHaar n literally reduces to Measure.haarMeasure on top PositiveCompacts of Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) R. Its dependency sets the measurable space to the Borel space of the inherited matrix topology; it obtains compactness from closedness/unitarity and coordinate norm bounds. Its probability proof uses haarMeasure_self on the whole compact group, not a determinant-component premise. Its map-left theorem invokes the same law's proved IsHaarMeasure property and map_mul_left_eq_self. Thus the component proof uses a genuine normalized full-group probability, not an uninterpreted prior or a probability typeclass supplied in its public signature. The imported uniqueness theorem is not an additional caller assumption and uniqueness is not needed by the component calculation.

WHOLE-MODULE INGREDIENT AUDIT: All five imports were read; Measure.Real supplies finite real-measure reasoning, and FunProp/Linarith/NormNum support the displayed local steps. The namespace contains exactly component_probabilities. classical and dsimp only resolve definitions; local lets merely abbreviate the actual law, carrier and events. hcont uses fun_prop on determinant restricted to the matrix subgroup; isClosed_eq with continuous_const yields hpos. hsign applies congrArg Matrix.det to mem_orthogonalGroup_iff, rewrites det_mul, det_transpose and det_one, and uses mul_self_eq_one_iff. hn forms i=0 in Fin n. R is an actual diagonal matrix with one -1; membership is proved using diagonal_transpose, diagonal_mul_diagonal, a pointwise case split, and diagonal_one. simp with det_diagonal proves hR=-1. hswap uses ext, coercion to matrix multiplication, det_mul, neg_one_mul and linarith. hequal uses orthogonalHaar_map_mul_left, Measure.map_apply, fun_prop measurability of multiplication, hpos and hswap. hcompl uses hsign plus norm_num to derive the exact complement identity. hadd uses this identity, measure_add_measure_compl hpos and the installed probability measure_univ. hp uses measure_ne_top for both masses, ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff', ENNReal.toReal_add, hequal, norm_num and linarith; hm transports hp via hequal. Each final IsProbabilityMeasure constructor uses Measure.smul_apply, Measure.restrict_apply_univ, its proved half-mass, and ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel with the required finite/nonzero proofs for 2. No field of the result is merely renamed or accepted as an assumption.

FIVE FORMULA-PROOF STEPS: (1) det(O)^2=1 follows from orthogonality; over R the signs are exhaustive and distinct, hence Cminus=Cplus complement. Positive-event Borel measurability is proved explicitly; negative-event measurability follows from that complement, so no missing premise is needed even though the code does not separately name hneg. (2) The coordinate reflection exists exactly because n>0, has determinant -1, and left multiplication has Cminus as the preimage of Cplus. The use of coordinate 0 is the Fin-index version of diag(-1,1,...,1), not a new source eigenbasis requirement. (3) The identical full-Haar law is invariant under that fixed reflection, and map_apply yields equal masses; the lesson explicitly calls this supplied omitted justification. (4) Complement additivity plus actual total mass 1 gives the mass equation, and probability finiteness makes the ENNReal-toReal computation sound; the code never cancels an infinite quantity. (5) Scaling each literal restriction on the original full-group carrier gives total mass exactly 2*(1/2)=1, which is precisely IsProbabilityMeasure. All five step texts, formulas and Lean explanations match the current whole proof.

BOUNDARIES: The result proves true normalized mixing priors on O(n) for each sign. It does not build the conditional Gaussian kernels, their measurability/integrability, or Gaussian target-mixture measures. It does not prove the H expectation split, the TV test inequality, determinant cancellation/spherical integration, adaptive posterior/transcript indistinguishability, eigenbasis/Krylov representations, parameter selection or either main query lower bound. These remain separate proof obligations; no claim that this component theorem discharges them is accepted. The lesson explicit boundary preserves those limits; module and source attribution preserve the distinction between the authors' application and the new elementary background elaboration.
